description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'fmt-merge-msg' functionality within the Git version control system. It sets up various test scenarios, executes commands, and verifies output related to merge message formatting, including handling of signatures, tags, branches, and configuration options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test case finishes.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable for testing.

methods.name: test_unconfig
methods.description: Unsets or resets a configuration variable.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test execution.
